- Generate a checked-in release plan from npm metadata.
- Bump only versions whose exact version already exists; retain ahead/unpublished versions.
- Update affected internal dependency ranges and the lockfile.
- Merge the release commit into `next` and require green CI.
- Create `<package-slug>-v<version>` tags at that exact commit, publishing foundations before dependants and throttling the tags.
- Verify every published version from npm afterward.
